title: census.py apply and factdiff.py apply write the same census.phase token, so the query log report cannot tell the phase-2 outcomes from factdiff's apply
goal: census.py apply records its census.phase row under a phase token factdiff.py does not write, and querylog.md and tools.md name it

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import census, factdiff
both = sorted(set(census.PHASES) & set(factdiff.PHASES))
print('phase tokens census.py and factdiff.py both write:', both)
sys.exit(1 if both else 0)
